# Codex SEO

> Codex-first SEO skill suite for technical SEO, content quality, schema, Core Web Vitals, GEO/AEO, local SEO, maps, backlinks, DataForSEO, Google APIs, Firecrawl, and Gemini image workflows.

## Project

- Repository: https://github.com/AgriciDaniel/codex-seo
- License: MIT
- Current version: 1.9.6+codex.1
- Canonical skill entrypoint: skills/ctk-seo/SKILL.md
- Plugin manifest: .codex-plugin/plugin.json
- Credits: CREDITS.md
- Initial Codex SEO conversion: https://github.com/avalonreset

## Install

- Reviewed fork: `gh repo clone ctkadvisors/codex-seo && cd codex-seo && ./install.sh`
- Windows: `gh repo clone ctkadvisors/codex-seo; cd codex-seo; .\install.ps1`

## Runtime Notes

- New config path: `~/.config/ctk-codex-seo/`
- New cache path: `~/.cache/ctk-codex-seo/`
- Project cache path: `~/.cache/ctk-codex-seo/`
- Credentials must stay outside the repository.
- Optional live-data providers return setup-required states when credentials or MCP servers are unavailable.

## Common Prompts

- `Do a full SEO check on https://example.com following best practices.`
- `$ctk-seo audit https://example.com`
- `$ctk-seo technical https://example.com`
- `$ctk-seo schema https://example.com`
- `$ctk-seo dataforseo serp "seo tools"`
